what_to_detect: A spell is a playable candidate (can_play true) for its sneak cost in the declare blockers step, its controller having an unblocked attacker to return.
near_miss: The sneak candidate is not playable (can_play false): outside the declare blockers step, or no unblocked attacker to return.
record_fields: decision candidate can_play, failed_checks phase / cost (gen-3)

verdict_bit has no parameter restricting the candidate to one keyword's line or zone: with fires_when true and no restriction, any playable candidate in any decision record fires, so the detector would tag nearly every decision record.

what_to_detect: A permanent spell resolves and its permanent enters the battlefield tapped and attacking the defender of another attacker (an added-to-combat entry), shown by a zone_change to the battlefield and the permanent's tapped and attacking state after the resolution.
near_miss: A permanent spell that resolves and enters untapped and not attacking.
record_fields: combat attacker list after the resolution
